source: lab (real recording, background replaced by a synthetic blue gradient with SAM2; watermark 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' bottom-right)
frame_time: t = frame / 24 (frame 0 at t = 0; last frame 48 at t = 2.000 s)
units: pixels and seconds; image origin top-left, x right, y down. No metric scale is assumed.

camera.motion: static. Both people's shoes stay fixed to <0.7 px std over all 49 frames (far person left shoe mean (713.4, 255.7), near person shoe mean (366.3, 675.8)); background is synthetic so it carries no motion information
camera.intrinsics_from_benchmark: Orbbec Femto Mega, HFOV 80 deg: f = 0.5959 * 1280 = 763 px, principal point ~ (640, 360)
camera.orientation_cue: camera looks steeply downward. Body axes of the two standing people (leg PCA at frame 0) converge at the vertical vanishing point ~ (835, 1068) (below the image), i.e. optical axis ~ 44 deg from the downward vertical / pitched ~45 deg down; horizon far above the image (roughly y ~ -400). Rough (+/- 10 deg): the near person's leg axis is used and she may not stand exactly vertical.
camera.depth_ordering: near person (lower-left, large) is close to the camera; far person (top centre, small, head cut off by the top edge) is far. The two objects are thrown between them, so the white object shrinks in the image during its flight (moving away) and the yellow toy grows (approaching).
